item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J02515","case1_error":"Inserts an unsupported $3,000 tax expense; 20% of the $5,000 pretax profit is $1,000.","case2_error":"Makes Richard 20 years younger, implying a negative current age; he must be older, giving a future combined age of 128.","reason":"The first introduces an unsupported tax amount; the second reverses the age relationship.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02516","case1_error":"Omits Bexley's nine added fish from the total before halving, then arbitrarily rounds the resulting fractional gift.","case2_error":"Incorrectly halves the harvest when picking it, then halves it again for the gift.","reason":"The first excludes an incoming quantity; the second inserts an extra halving operation.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02517","case1_error":"Omits the $20 flat fee from the total deposit.","case2_error":"Omits the $400 food budget from total spending before calculating savings.","reason":"Both omit a required additive component when forming the total.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J02518","case1_error":"Gives an unsupported $100 final profit after a correct profit formula; also writes a per-mile expression missing necessary parentheses.","case2_error":"Evaluates the correctly written seven-day sum as 107 instead of 97.","reason":"The first supplies an unsupported final number and a malformed intermediate relation; the second explicitly miscalculates a correctly written sum.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02519","case1_error":"States an unsupported total of 22 after correctly specifying (56 / 8) + (48 / 6), which yields 15.","case2_error":"States an unsupported total of 960 after correctly specifying 120 + (6 * 120), which yields 840.","reason":"Both present correct formulas followed by incorrect final numbers without showing the numerical calculations producing them.","judgment":"same"}]}
